comment: PEDAL BUILD manifest for Fahhh. build.py reads THIS file. A pick-triggered sampler in the spirit of Zoom's stock Bomber: every picked note fires the embedded 'Fahhh' recording, optionally retuned to the note played, with its own delay that touches only the sample.
gid_comment: 0x07 = SFX category -> SONAME prefix ZDL_SFX_, next to Zoom's Bomber (SFX 7/32). The owner's choice; the rest of the pack is Delay (8). gid and the Fx_SFX_ prefix must match or the pedal freezes.
fxid_comment: Free in the SFX group (stock SFX uses 16-208; probes CtxWatch 447 and 448) and used nowhere else in the repo. Check repeat98's FXID registry before the first hardware flash.
dsp_cost_comment: Estimate, not measured: two interpolated sample voices, a 1.2 s delay and onset tracking every sample, plus a YIN pitch search spread over ~30 blocks after each pick (5 lags x 256 points a block).

params.name: Mix
params.comment: Dry/wet. 0 passes the guitar unchanged; 100 is the sample and its echoes only.

params.name: Time
params.comment: Delay time on the sample only: 0 = no delay, then 20 ms .. 1.2 s (quadratic, 50 = 315 ms). Moves glide, so turning it bends the echoes.

params.name: Fdbk
params.comment: Delay feedback on the sample only, 0 .. 0.92, darkened and soft-clipped in the loop.

params.name: Sens
params.comment: Pick sensitivity: how quiet a pick still fires the sample. 0 = only hard picks, 100 = the lightest touch.

params.name: Pitch
params.comment: 0 = Orig: the recording at its own pitch. 1 = Note: retuned to the note picked (folded by octaves into B2..B4, the recording's own B3 +-1 octave).

audio_nop_comment: Set true for a UI-only smoke build before trusting the DSP.
params_order_comment: Menu order chosen by the owner: Mix, Time, Fdbk on page 1 (and on the cover), Sens and the Pitch selector on page 2. fahhh.c reads each knob by name (FAHHH_<NAME>_SLOT), so reordering here changes no DSP.
